title: Dulles greenlights the S force against JFK
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Dulles greenlights the S force against JFK, about 1963 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, what he did is just greenlighted the S force.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and activist, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1963 Allen Dulles, the former head of the CIA, gave the go-ahead to a group Sheehan calls the S force, set against President John F. Kennedy. Sheehan also names Richard Bissell, another senior CIA man, in the story. If true, it would put former CIA leadership behind a move against the president, in an episode that links Kennedy to UFO secrets.
